title: Full AES-128 biclique, minimal-kp, 2 known pair(s) [BCGS15]

target.description: Standard full 10-round AES-128 with standard expanded master key and final-round convention. First-round star of dimension8; key indices in master-key bytes0,1; matching byte12 in state#11.

setting.key_relation: One unknown standard AES master key and its standard expanded round keys.
setting.plaintext_model: 2 known plaintext-ciphertext pair(s) under one key; no chosen-input or related-key oracle is required. Star starts at first round.
assumptions: Author-reported exhaustive search is limited to the Section5 truncated independent balanced-biclique/star class; displayed structures have dimension8.
Key modifications have a common linear key state for complete key coverage; related-key differences are offline computations, not related-secret-key oracle access.
setting.reference_model: One unknown standard AES master key; full recovery is distinguished from merely enumerating its key-space group.
